plan.title: Extend upcoming RFQ by one hour

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ without recreating or searching for it.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Record the RFQ's displayed start time before extending submission time.
Use Settings → Extend Submission Time with a custom one-hour increase and verify Procol reports the new end as one hour after the previous end.
Confirm the displayed bidding start remains unchanged after the extension.
